_comment: Phase-2 fixture audit: every save/movie sha256-pinned and classified by identified media. Non-pristine fixtures are retained but ineligible for oracle construction. Regenerate: tools/phase2_oracle.py.
note: movie identity headers carry serial but NOT the disc image hash; a pristine-serial movie recorded on a MOD disc is indistinguishable by header alone — cold-boot oracle movies must therefore be replayed against the pristine image to be accepted (oracle rule).
